data.rationale: The proposal gets the goal, the email subject and body template, and the discard ending, but it omits the blog parameter and the new-tab visit to the blog for the latest post (wrongly looking for it on the GitHub profile/README). It also treats followers, stars, language and latest_post as input parameters instead of values to extract, hardcodes no recipient default, and adds a spurious Users filter step and "or Send" ambiguity, so it can't be automated from the spec alone.
